selection: Three different progression/style groups and performers, accompaniment microphone recordings; excludes known timing-error files. No selection by measured outcome.
role: Initial baseline diagnostic; no parameter fitting. Once inspected, these are development data, never reused as blind confirmation.
automatic: LibrosaBeatAnalyzer defaults plus ChromagramChordAnalyzer defaults at 44100Hz
diagnostic_only: Same chord analyzer with annotated beats, explicitly not an automatic result
limits: Three real guitar excerpts are not three commercial mixed songs. No vocal extraction, melody recognition or synthesized accompaniment quality claim. Do not tune until all results and failures are reported.
reservation_note: Reserved after first baseline inspection, before any method changes; distinct progression groups from pilot. Not downloaded or scored.
